name: Open Counsel
description: Matter-scoped document review and redlining for legal teams. Upload contracts and diligence packs, define the questions once, and let your agent fill a spreadsheet-style review grid across every document — where each answer is only accepted if its supporting quote is verifiably present in the source text. Then propose changes and get a Word file with real tracked changes. Save proven column sets as firm-wide workflows. An open-source alternative to Harvey and Legora.

deploy.title: Deploy your Open Counsel
deploy.subtitle: Matter workspaces, cited document review, and reusable firm workflows.
